learner_starting_state: Can distinguish major AI workload families but may know responsible AI only as vocabulary.
learner_ending_state: Can identify the primary responsible AI principle in a scenario and connect it to an affected stakeholder, concrete mitigation, and accountable human owner.
mastery_gate: Score 24 of 24 on both primary and fresh-transfer forms, demonstrate every principle twice, and explain one closed-note response using principle, stakeholder, mitigation, and owner.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: Principle names and the Discover-Protect-Govern lifecycle trace to current official Microsoft sources; scenarios, distractors, and gates are course-authored.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Treat multiple-principle interpretations as possible; select the closest primary harm and do not present course scenarios as Microsoft exam questions.

notes: Compact scenario package with two deterministic forms and strict four-dimension readiness gate.
